entries.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: isolated map-character sprite atlas for a three-quarter top-down RPG. On a perfectly flat uniform pale cream #F7F0DE background, show exactly four isolated full-body views of the same unnamed adult first-century Judean observer in one horizontal row, evenly spaced and not overlapping. Exact orientation is mandatory: figure 1 faces mostly toward the viewer; figure 2 faces directly away from the viewer; figure 3 is a side profile with nose and toes pointing to the image's RIGHT edge; figure 4 is the mirrored opposite side profile with nose and toes pointing to the image's LEFT edge. The observer is modest and visually secondary, Middle Eastern appearance, medium-brown skin, dark brown hair mostly covered by a simple dusty-olive head cloth, natural-linen knee-length tunic, muted-blue sleeveless outer wrap, rope belt and plain leather sandals. Neutral attentive expression, hands relaxed, restrained stance, adult anatomy with head about one seventh of body height, no weapon and no speaking gesture. Match a three-quarter top-down game camera so feet and shoulders read clearly. Polished warm hand-painted storybook realism, clean silhouette, subtle gouache texture, upper-left natural light and a compact soft shadow directly under each figure. The image must contain only the four figures and the flat empty background: absolutely no title, caption, direction name, lettering, symbol, border or typography anywhere.

revision.target: Correct the fourth profile orientation after both v2 candidates repeated a right-facing profile.
revision.changeOnly: Make figure 4 face the image's left edge.
revision.keepUnchanged: Text-free output, four-view order, observer identity, clothing, restrained pose, adult proportions, palette, lighting and removable background.
revision.acceptance: Figure 3 nose and toes point right; figure 4 nose and toes point left; no typography remains.

must: Exactly four views of one identical observer in one row
Full body and feet visible with consistent identity
Adult non-chibi proportions and restrained neutral stance
First-century Judean clothing and upper-left light
avoid: Speech, pointing, prayer or miracle gesture
Weapon, armor, royal clothing, modern object
visualAcceptance: All four views clearly depict one identity and costume
Silhouette reads at 96-112 runtime pixels tall
Observer remains visually secondary and theologically neutral
Perspective, palette and light match the world

must: Exactly four ordered states of the same man
Blind, clay-applied, seeing and restrained belief poses
Identity, clothing and body proportions unchanged across states
